cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:37.title: Electrical Superintendent
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:37.description: Our client is looking for a Lead Electrician who is accountable for running assigned electrical work in the field from mobilization through completion. This role creates value by delivering safe, code-compliant, high-quality work, keeping jobs moving on schedule, leading helpers and apprentices effectively, communicating job status clearly, and minimizing callbacks and rework. The Lead Electrician is the field owner of execution on assigned jobs. That includes planning day-to-day work, identifying material and labor needs, checking quality before leaving the site, maintaining safety standards, and making sure the office and leadership team have the information needed to manage the business well.
responsibilities: Job execution and field leadership
Lead assigned jobs in the field and take ownership for execution, workmanship, and day-to-day progress.
Review the scope of work, assess actual field conditions, and adjust installation approach as needed while keeping leadership informed of meaningful changes.
Complete work to code, company standards, and customer expectations.
Maintain momentum on the job and make sound field decisions that keep work moving without sacrificing quality.
Schedule and production management
Manage daily production against the expected timeline for the job.
Coordinate labor, tools, and materials needed to complete work efficiently.
Flag scope issues, labor shortages, material gaps, or site constraints early so schedule impacts can be addressed before they become failures.
Balance speed with workmanship, recognizing that finishing fast only matters when the work is right.
Quality control and callback prevention
Inspect completed work before leaving the site to verify quality, completeness, and code compliance.
Check the work of helpers and apprentices and correct issues in real time.
Confirm materials, devices, connections, tools, and cleanup are complete before job closeout or transition.
Reduce avoidable rework, missed items, and callbacks by using disciplined self-checks and field oversight.
Safety and compliance
Lead safe work practices on every assigned job.
Ensure proper PPE, lockout/tagout, hazard awareness, barricades, and site-specific safety requirements are followed.
Maintain a safe work area for crew members, customers, and other trades.
Stop unsafe work and correct unsafe behavior immediately.
Reporting and communication
Provide timely field updates to leadership on job progress, delays, material needs, schedule risks, and completion status.
Submit or support accurate work orders, labor reporting, and job notes as required.
Communicate clearly with the office and leadership so customer expectations, billing support, and scheduling decisions stay aligned with field reality.
Escalate major issues early rather than letting the office or customer find out late.
Helper and apprentice development
Direct the work of assigned helpers and apprentices in the field.
Teach proper installation methods, safe work habits, and jobsite expectations.
Hold assigned crew members accountable for attendance, work quality, pace, and conduct.
Develop apprentices toward greater independence while protecting job quality and safety.
qualifications: Journeyman or Master Electrician capability preferred, with strong field leadership experience.
Strong knowledge of commercial, industrial, and service electrical work.
Able to read plans, assess field conditions, and identify material and labor needs.
Able to lead helpers and apprentices while maintaining quality and safety.
Strong judgment, accountability, and communication in fast-moving field conditions.
Valid driver’s license and clean driving record preferred.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:172.title: Accounting Manager - Month-End Close & Operations - AI/LLM Expertise
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:172.description: CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs. Reports to: Shared Services Finance Leadership Location: Remote (US or Canada — must be available during US Central business hours)
responsibilities: Month-End Close
Drive the full close cycle to completion within the 5-day target window and continuously work to compress it

Prepare and post the complete slate of recurring journal entries — amortizations, prepaid schedules (insurance, advertising, IT, freight), and accruals (unpaid vendor bills, shipping, transportation fees, payroll, sales returns & allowances)
Own balance sheet reconciliations, intercompany entries, reclasses, and cash/bank entries across accounts (Ramp, Stripe, sales tax, and bank transactions)
Process all payroll-related journal entries
Coordinate cross-functional close inputs (inventory, delayed revenue, loyalty true-ups, intercompany files) and keep the critical path moving
Maintain close documentation, checklists, and the journal-entry support library; ensure SOX-style controls and a clean audit trail
Accounts Payable & Vendor Financial Relationships
Own AP operations end-to-end: bill processing, payment proposals, aging management, and vendor account reconciliation
Serve as the financial point of contact for vendors — fulfill reporting requests, reconcile statements, and resolve short-pay, allowance, and credit disputes with clean, data-backed analysis
Provide financial documentation for vendor credit-line and partnership discussions in coordination with merchandising/buying teams and leadership
Partner with merchandising/buying teams on vendor policy matters (allowances, restock, returns)
AI & Automation
Use AI as a daily tool — and Python where it helps — to eliminate manual accounting work, automating JE preparation, reconciliations, AP workflows, and vendor reporting
Champion an AI-first approach to accounting operations: use LLMs (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) as a daily analysis partner and build solutions ranging from CustomGPTs to automated workflows
Prototype and deploy agent-based automations (e.g., n8n) and build lightweight utilities or micro-apps (e.g., with Claude Code) to scale output and shrink the close
Build and maintain reliable, auditable integrations and queries against NetSuite (ODBC/SuiteAnalytics), bank portals, and other financial systems
Operationalize recurring reconciliations and accruals into always-on checks and alerts that flag exceptions before they hit the close
General Ledger & Business Support
Ensure the general ledger is accurate, complete, and GAAP-compliant; support external audit and tax requests
Produce reconciled, GL-level actuals and driver detail that feed the FP&A team's forecasting, planning, and executive reporting
Identify and remediate process gaps, control weaknesses, and recurring discrepancies at the root cause
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
5+ years in accounting/finance with direct, hands-on ownership of a full month-end close
Strong technical accounting fundamentals: accruals, prepaids, reclasses, intercompany, and balance sheet reconciliations under GAAP
Hands-on AP experience, including direct vendor communication and dispute resolution
Daily working familiarity with AI/LLM tools and a demonstrated track record of applying them to eliminate manual finance work
Strong SQL for data extraction and transformation; advanced Excel
Solid grasp of GAAP and core accounting principles
Hands-on experience with payroll journal entries and payroll platforms (e.g., Paylocity)
Multi-entity / multi-brand accounting experience
Able to walk through an automation you personally built and shipped — what it does, how, and the time it saved
Highly organized, deadline-driven, and comfortable owning a process under a hard monthly clock
CPA or MBA
Proficiency in Python for data work and automation (e.g., pandas; scripting against APIs and databases)
Hands-on experience with workflow-automation and agent platforms (e.g., n8n) and building micro-apps/utilities (e.g., Claude Code)
Deep, hands-on experience with NetSuite (SuiteAnalytics/ODBC)
Familiarity with AP and payment platforms (e.g., Stripe, Ramp)
E-commerce or retail industry experience

jobgether-jobgether:lever:11570f71-e8f8-.title: Head of Legal & Compliance
jobgether-jobgether:lever:11570f71-e8f8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Legal & Compliance based in Ireland. This is a senior, hands-on legal and compliance leadership role within a fast-growing AI-powered B2B technology environment. You will own the legal framework surrounding data, AI-powered calling, privacy, telemarketing compliance, and enterprise customer requirements. The role is designed to be built from the ground up, giving you significant ownership over processes, policies, and risk frameworks. You will work directly with Product and Engineering, helping shape features and technical decisions rather than reviewing them only after development. You will also lead commercial negotiations and enterprise legal and security reviews, helping remove friction from strategic deals. The position requires strong judgment, commercial awareness, and the ability to translate complex regulations into practical product requirements. It is an opportunity to establish a scalable legal and compliance function while becoming a trusted advisor across the business. Own the legal and compliance framework for AI-powered calling and dialer functionality, including TCPA requirements, consent, do-not-call obligations, call recording, and disclosures relating to AI-generated voice. Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure compliance requirements are implemented directly within platform workflows, controls, and technical processes. Manage external specialist legal advisors, including a TCPA-focused firm, and determine which matters should be escalated externally versus handled internally. Lead the privacy program across applicable regulations, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and emerging US state privacy requirements. Manage data-subject requests, opt-outs, data broker registration requirements, and other operational privacy processes. Own data sourcing and governance practices, including supplier diligence, lawful-basis assessments, legitimate interest assessments, DPIAs, and transfer impact assessments. Serve as the designated DPO and establish an effective approach to AI governance as new AI and agentic capabilities are introduced. Draft, review, and negotiate customer and vendor agreements, data processing agreements, and other commercial legal documentation. Lead enterprise security and privacy reviews, working to remove legal and compliance barriers that could delay or prevent strategic customer opportunities. Serve as a key legal contact for enterprise customers and their counsel, building confidence and helping facilitate successful commercial relationships. Participate directly in product and roadmap planning, identifying regulatory considerations early enough to influence product design and development. Translate regulatory requirements into clear, practical product and engineering requirements that teams can implement effectively. Assess emerging regulatory developments, distinguish material risks from overly cautious interpretations, and help the business move quickly while maintaining appropriate compliance standards. Build and scale legal and compliance processes from the ground up, establishing only the frameworks, controls, and documentation that create meaningful business value. Requirements 8+ years of combined law firm and in-house legal experience, with qualification to practice law in the United States. Deep, practical privacy experience, particularly with GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, including applying these frameworks to real products, data flows, and business operations. Strong experience advising Product and Engineering teams and participating directly in technical and product decision-making. Proven ability to establish or significantly develop a legal and compliance function in an early-stage or high-growth environment. Strong understanding of data privacy, data sourcing, AI governance, and regulatory risk management. Experience with TCPA, telephony, dia

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1e183a40-7704-.title: Sr. Experiential Event Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1e183a40-7704-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Experiential Event Manager based in United States. The Sr. Experiential Event Manager will lead high-impact field marketing, executive events, and experiential programs designed to generate measurable business results. This senior individual contributor will own programs from strategy and audience planning through execution, measurement, and optimization. The role will connect experiential marketing closely with account-based marketing, sales priorities, and broader go-to-market initiatives. You will use data, technology, and audience insights to create experiences that engage strategic accounts and buying groups. Success will require balancing creativity and exceptional attendee experiences with rigorous budget, operational, and ROI discipline. You will collaborate extensively with sales, marketing, revenue teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners in a fast-moving environment. The ideal candidate is an analytical, proactive, and hands-on marketer who can turn events into scalable programs that influence pipeline and revenue. Own the end-to-end planning, execution, and optimization of executive events, field programs, flagship events, and experiential activations aligned with revenue objectives. Translate go-to-market priorities into structured, audience-centric event programs with clear objectives, KPIs, messaging, and measurable outcomes. Design and deliver high-quality in-person, virtual, and hybrid experiences while maintaining consistent brand, operational, and attendee experience standards. Integrate events into broader account-based marketing and go-to-market campaigns rather than treating them as standalone activities. Partner with sales leadership, revenue marketing, and field teams to identify priority accounts and buying groups and support targeted pre-event engagement strategies. Establish effective post-event follow-up processes that drive engagement, sales acceleration, and measurable pipeline contribution. Provide sales and marketing stakeholders with visibility into event performance, engagement insights, and opportunities for optimization. Manage relationships with venues, agencies, vendors, and strategic partners while maintaining strong budget control, quality standards, and cost efficiency. Maintain detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and cross-functional coordination across marketing, content, product, operations, and other stakeholder groups. Leverage marketing technology and data platforms to improve audience targeting, registration quality, attendee engagement, and performance tracking. Collaborate with ABX, product marketing, demand generation, content, growth, and marketing operations teams to align experiences with broader business objectives. Influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority by bringing expertise, clear frameworks, and actionable recommendations. Analyze program performance and translate results into insights, best practices, and recommendations that can improve future experiential initiatives and scale successful approaches across regions. Requirements: 8–12 years of experience in field marketing, experiential marketing, or event marketing, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment. Deep expertise in account-based marketing/account-based experience (ABM/ABX) and field marketing strategy and execution. Demonstrated success using events and experiential programs to influence pipeline, revenue, engagement, and sales outcomes. Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate credibly and effectively with senior leaders and strategic stakeholders. Proven experience partnering closely with sales, revenue, and go-to-market teams. southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:1fffd796.title: Executive Business Partner (CEO, VP of Finance, VP of People)
southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:1fffd796.description: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an Executive Business Partner to support our CEO, VP of Finance, and VP of People. You’ll be a force multiplier across the executive team: managing complex calendars, driving critical follow-through, and, above all, representing these leaders’ voices in writing and in person with precision and polish. Because you’ll routinely draft, edit, and speak on behalf of executives across the company, this role calls for a very high bar for written and verbal communication: clear, correct, well-organized, and appropriately toned for the audience, every time. This role is a great fit for someone who embodies Render’s Operating Principles https://render.com/careers, particularly Own impact and outcomes (you anticipate needs before being asked), Raise the quality bar (you take real pride in the quality of every email, deck, and invite that carries a leader’s name), Reason clearly; execute quickly (you triage and act fast, even with incomplete information), and Build together (you build trust quickly with a wide range of stakeholders across the company).
